semiconductor_relevance: High — Marubeni Information Systems specializes in advanced bonding equipment and technologies crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Marubeni Information Systems provides cutting-edge bonding equipment for semiconductors, utilizing surface activation technology for high-precision alignment. Their offerings include systems for both research and mass production, capable of handling various materials and wafer sizes up to 12 inches.
capabilities: Ultra-high vacuum room temperature bonding systems
Hydrophilic bonding systems with ±0.2 μm alignment precision
